title: Florida pastor found guilty over 2021 assassination of Haitian president
summary_full: Christian Emmanuel Sanon faces life in prison after conviction on charges arising from killing of Jovenel MoïseA Florida pastor with dual Haitian-American citizenship was convicted on Wednesday of US charges arising from the 2021 assassination of the Haitian president Jovenel Moïse.Christian Emmanuel Sanon was found guilty on charges including conspiring to kill Moïse after a nearly eight-week trial in federal court in Miami. He had faced a total of eight charges including conspiracy to kidnap or kill a person outside the United States. Continue reading...
